answer: Stake a scarce opal-backed bond at each agent's vertex: every new identity must lock collateral forfeit on proven duplication. A sybil splitter gains extra emissions per fake node but loses the bond plus reputation each time one vertex is caught, and peers expose the flock by pattern-matching behavior the way a sparrow flock clusters. As detection probability rises, marginal gain turns negative; equilibrium is honest single identities where expected payout never exceeds bond plus slash risk.
